description_zh: 调用DeleteNatRateLimitRule接口删除限速规则
name: DeleteNatRateLimitRule

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
NAT网关所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway to which the rate limiting rule belongs
parameters.help_zh: 限速规则所属 NAT 网关所在的地域 ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the rate limiting rules to be deleted
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的限速规则的ID列表
parameters.name: rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value on your client. Make sure that the client token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
